S = S_grav + S_phi + S_m, with

S_grav = ∫d^4x sqrt(-g) (M_Pl^2/2) F(phi) R

S_phi = ∫d^4x sqrt(-g) [ P(phi,X) + Q(phi,X) Box(phi) + A1(phi,X) ( phi_{mu nu} phi^{mu nu} - (Box phi)^2 ) ]

S_m = ∫d^4x sqrt(-g_tilde) L_m[ g_tilde_{mu nu}, Psi_m ],

canonical.claimed_static_limit: In the static, slowly-varying regime (X -> 0, phi ~ const to leading order) with F,Omega -> 1 + O(phi/M, X/M^4) and Gamma -> O(1/M^4), the action formally reduces to General Relativity plus a canonically normalized scalar with weak-field PPN-type parameters expressible as Taylor coefficients of F, Omega, Gamma at X=0. No specific numerical PPN bound, Newtonian-limit fit, or agreement with any measurement is claimed; whether this limit is phenomenologically viable is unknown pending the vacuum/Newtonian asymptotics and Solar-System control gates.
evasion_rationale: Repeated rejections clustered at universal_minimal_matter_coupling across gradient_state, measured_state, flux, and saturation mechanism tags suggest prior candidates used per-object or per-species coupling functions; this proposal instead builds a single disformal metric g_tilde from only two universal functions of (phi,X), applied identically to all matter, to directly target that gate.

The gradient_state, flux, and saturation mechanism tags are folded into a single grammar: X = g^{mu nu} phi_mu phi_nu covers gradient_state and the flux-like current phi^mu, while a bounded saturating basis element (tanh(X/M^4)) covers the saturation tag; measured_state is covered by bare phi-dependence, so one construction spans all four previously-failing mechanism tags rather than proposing four separate ad hoc couplings.

Repeated rejections at higher_derivative_degeneracy_declaration indicate prior higher-derivative candidates lacked explicit machine-readable degeneracy relations; here the only second-derivative-of-phi term is written in the fixed combination A1(phi_{mu nu}phi^{mu nu} - (Box phi)^2), with the underlying A2=-A1 relation and the A3=A4=A5=0 grammar exclusions stated as explicit equalities rather than prose.

None of this constitutes proof that the gates will be passed; the degeneracy conditions and dof count are declared and unverified, and must still be checked against the pipeline's own Hamiltonian, hyperbolicity, and covariance-identity analyses.
canonical.expected_dof: Under the five declared degeneracy conditions (all currently "declared_unverified"), the naive expectation is 2 tensor + 1 scalar = 3 propagating degrees of freedom, matching the class-Ia DHOST/beyond-Horndeski counting for this restricted (F_X=0, A3=A4=A5=0) subclass. This count is a structural expectation from the literature pattern being mimicked, not a result of an independent Hamiltonian/constraint analysis performed here; the kinetic-rank and constraint-counting gate is expected to either confirm or falsify it.
falsification_tests: Solar-System light-deflection and Shapiro time-delay timing measurements, compared to the PPN parameters implied by the Taylor coefficients of F, Omega, Gamma at X near zero.
Binary pulsar orbital-period-decay timing, compared to the gravitational-wave and scalar-radiation rates predicted by P, Q, A1 in the weak-field, slow-motion expansion.

Direct arrival-time comparison between a gravitational-wave signal and a simultaneously detected electromagnetic counterpart from the same transient event, bounding the propagation-speed difference implied by A1 and Gamma.
Laboratory and satellite equivalence-principle / fifth-force tests bounding Gamma(phi,X) and the phi-dependence of Omega at small X.

Spectroscopically measured galactic rotation velocities compared directly against baryonic mass inferred from stellar photometry and gas column density in the same objects, testing whether Omega(phi,X) reproduces the required acceleration profile without any per-object fit parameter.

Invertibility of g_tilde (Omega(Omega + X Gamma) != 0) is a domain-of-validity requirement, not a degeneracy condition, and is left unverified here.
